messages:
sam: quick review — need copy for the confirmation modal when an org admin changes the org default model. dropping a draft below, please flag clarity/accessibility/cost wording.

sam: Draft:
```
Set organization default model
Are you sure you want to set "gpt-neox-2.7b" as your organization's default model? This will affect new deployments and may change inference costs for teams using the default.
[Cancel] [Confirm]
```

anya: quick thoughts — title feels fine but 'Are you sure' is a bit blunt. also we should say whether existing deployments update or not.

devin: +1 on clarifying impact. also 'may change inference costs' is vague and might alarm folks. could soften with 'this may affect average cost per request for teams that rely on the default'.

marta: a11y nit — primary action needs an aria-label that includes the model name (e.g., "Confirm change default model to gpt-neox-2.7b"). add a "Learn more" link to docs about defaults. Also use sentence case in the body.

aria: suggestion for tighter microcopy: Title -> 'Set organization default model' (strong verb). Body -> 'Setting a new org default applies to newly created routes and deployments. Pinned model versions on existing deployments will not change. This may affect average inference cost.'

sam: good call to switch to 'Set' — keeps it actionable. can we get that down to 2–3 short lines for mobile?

anya: proposed compact copy:
```
Set organization default model
Set "gpt-neox-2.7b" as your org default. This applies to new deployments; pinned versions are unchanged. This may affect average inference cost.
[Cancel] [Set default]
```

devin: I like that. button label 'Set default' is clearer than 'Confirm'. order: secondary on left, primary on right (OK). :thumbsup:

marta: nit — for screen readers include hidden text on the primary button: "Set default model to gpt-neox-2.7b". also add a small help link text: "Learn more about org defaults" linking to /docs/org-defaults.

copybot: suggestion: shorten second sentence to 'Applies to new deployments; existing pinned versions remain unchanged.' and replace 'may affect' with 'may affect average inference cost.'

sam: great. @anya can you update the Figma frame and attach a screenshot? I'll send to eng after you drop the asset. If no objections I'll mark approved by EOD.

anya: updating Figma now, will post screenshot in a few mins.

devin: backend FYI — we'll require org_id + model_id for the call; UI should send model_id. no other changes needed.

sam: thanks. closing in a few hours unless objections.
